source.stem:
The graph represents the motion of a train travelling between two stations.
0 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 Which statement about the train is correct?

options.text: Its acceleration takes a longer time than its deceleration.
It travels at constant speed for less than half of its journey time.
It travels 2000 m in the first 100 s.
It travels 10⁰⁰0 m at constant speed.

intelligence.enrichment: Average speed over an interval is total distance covered divided by total time taken, even when the object does not move with the same speed during the whole interval. Adding all segment distances and all segment times gives one distance-per-time value for the whole interval. The learner correctly applies this rule: Average speed over an interval is total distance covered divided by total time taken, even when the object does not move with the same speed during the whole interval. Average speed is the speed the object must have had throughout the whole trip.
